policy.metric: 100 × Euclidean Oklab distance between robust component centers; not total rendering accuracy
policy.rejection: Discard paper pixels below 65% of local median HSV brightness, then discard tiles retaining less than 65%; apply to source and reference equally.
policy.admission: At least 3 calibration / 2 reserved; reserved median improvement >0.25; worst reserved regression <=1; no >1% tile clipping; fixed-window sensitivity <=1. Texture mismatch remains flagged separately. Opt-in trial only.
policy.split: Card-name hash order; basic-land variants share a name and do not constitute independent card-name validation.
policy.limitations: No color chart or scan white balance. These profiles match this cached Scryfall corpus, not measured physical print colors. Geometry frozen at v78; fixed eroded windows avoid edge registration. Artwork, text, border stock and mana are outside fitted components.
